pairs.probe: On stable ground, use the displayed jump control. Verify genuine upward displacement followed by descent and landing; repeating should work. A cosmetic change without displacement is insufficient. This focused probe does not certify raised-platform landing.

Verify solid ground and a raised platform: jump onto the raised platform, release movement and remain supported for at least two seconds. Check that the raised surface is not merely decorative. A failed approach alone does not demonstrate a collision defect.

From rest on a clear stretch, apply throttle. Verify visible displacement of the vehicle relative to world scenery over time, consistent with acceleration. Speedometer or minimap changes alone are insufficient.

Compare releasing throttle with using the displayed brake, on the same clear stretch at a comparable initial speed and over matched time windows. Braking must slow the vehicle more than natural coasting before a collision; confirm world motion as well as HUD. Restart for comparable starting conditions.
